caption:
A month after crossing 800 million transactions a day, UPI just broke its own record again. This time, the average day crossed Rs 1 lakh crore.

UPI processed a record 25.47 billion transactions worth Rs 31.53 lakh crore in October 2026 - and for the first time ever, the average daily transaction value crossed Rs 1 lakh crore. That's up from September's 24.07 billion transactions, a 5.8% rise in volume and 7.4% rise in value in just one month. Year-on-year, volume grew roughly 23% and value grew roughly 16% compared to October 2025.

Every record UPI sets gets treated as a ceiling. Every month, it turns out to be a floor.

Sources: Entrepreneur India, Outlook Money, citing NPCI data (2026)
